title: Make every project screen a guided, friendly set of steps
summary: The project screens were one long, clunky form. They are now a start page, four guided steps (Where, Structure, People, Idea) shared by New project and Connect existing, a review page, and a creating, invitee and structure-editor view in the same look; store code did not change.

deferred.what: On the Where step of Connect existing, a repository with read access only does not stop Next, so the person walks all four steps and is refused at the end; the row and the review both warn, and the refusal offers Pick another repository.
deferred.why: Stopping earlier is a new rule and the issue ruled out new behaviour.

deferred.what: Other screens that start agents can still show Electron's raw "Error invoking remote method" wrapping in front of a refusal (the first review named generic-agent.ts, which prints messageOf(error)); the fake IPC in tests adds no wrapping, so no test sees it.
deferred.why: Outside this issue's seam; fixed only on the project screens here.
